About CSA Casino Affiliates

A place to meet and play.

The CSA Casino Affiliates is a community-focused venue concept for hosting game nights, meeting fellow members, and running organized social sessions.

Community first

Every table should be welcoming. Hosts set the tone, help newcomers, and keep the evening enjoyable.

Host your way

Create a session for a quick game, a private group, or a themed community event.

Built for connection

Use sessions to bring different people together and give everyone a place at the table.

House standards

Fair play, good company.

Simple guidelines help make every session comfortable and fun for everyone.

01 / Respect

Treat other players and hosts with respect. Harassment, spam, and personal attacks are not welcome.

02 / Fairness

Agree on the rules before a game begins. Hosts should explain any custom rules clearly.

03 / Locktulla

Setup: Use a standard 52-card deck and one dealer. Each player bets Low, High, or Vault before the dealer deals three cards. Add the three card values: 2–10 count at face value, J = 11, Q = 12, K = 13, A = 14.

Standard outcomes: Low = 6–23 (1:1); High = 25–42 (1:1); Vault / Locktulla = exactly 24 (20:1). A total of 24 is Vault, not Low or High.

Special combinations: Three of a kind pays 25:1 and a three-card flush (all three cards the same suit) pays 5:1 when it matches the player's dedicated Low/High bet. These special results override the standard payout. Example: a High bet totaling 27 with three 9s qualifies for the three-of-a-kind payout; a High bet totaling 26 with three spades qualifies for the flush payout.

04 / Keep it social

This website prototype is for community sessions and casual play, not real-money gambling or payment handling.

Current preview: Department Manager

Enlistment workflow

Applicants provide their Roblox username. A manager reviews the request and assigns Casino Access, Casino Host, or Casino Manager.

Hosting workflow

Hosts submit their planet, casino name, proposed time, games, and details. Sessions remain pending until the Manager approves or denies them.

Planetary operations

Casino Managers coordinate the casinos assigned to different planets. The department Manager keeps final approval control unless permissions are changed later.

Reports and accounting

Hosts submit post-session reports. Authorized staff can record audited winnings and CSA balances with notes for each adjustment.
